text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - World Bank experts will hold a five-day visit to Slovakia this week, to work out a report on the status of the Slovak economy.
- Slovakia consumed 28.8 million MWh of electricity in 1996. The country imported 12.4 percent of the total.
- State-owned Slovenska Posta (SP) posted a 90 million crowns loss for the last year, against originally estimated losses of 600 million crowns.
- Slovenska Posta and commercial bank Postova Banka a.s. are planning a 400 million crown bond issue for the end of April. The bond is expected to have an interest rate of 12 to 13.5 percent.
SLOVENSKA REPUBLIKA - The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) will organise the next state bond auction on January 28.
- Slovakia's 1996 state budget deficit totalled to 25.5 billion crowns, the Ministry of Finance said.

NARODNA OBRODA - The opposition Democratic Union (DU), led by former Prime Minister Jozef Moravcik and the Social Democratic party of Slovakia (SDSS) approved an agreement on political cooperation between the two parties.

PRACA - More than 100,000 citizens so far have signed the petition for the referendum on the direct presidential election in the country, which has been organised by some opposition political parties.
- Slovak and Ukrainian government officials discussed the possibility of opening a direct cargo train railway line between Bratislava and Kiev.
